name: Civitai Radio
tagline: Play Civitai collections like a music player.
description:
Civitai Radio plays the videos in a Civitai collection one after another, like a music player. It starts with the Music Focus collection. Your own collections appear beside it, and any public collection opens from its link. Star tracks to save them to your private Favorites playlist.

Shuffle and repeat, a queue that shows what already played, keyboard shortcuts, and media keys and lock-screen controls where your browser allows them. The Details tab shows how the current video was made: its prompt, settings and resources. Reaction counts and comments link back to Civitai.

It remembers your favorites, volume, shuffle and repeat, the playlist you had on, and collections you opened by link. Only you can see these, and you can empty them from your Civitai account settings.

The app only reads Civitai collections.
